POWER MECHANICS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #1
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: POWER MECHANICS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Limits, fits and tolerance, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Limits, fits and tolerance.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Limits, fits and tolerance.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Limits, fits and tolerance.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Limits, fits and tolerance.

2. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   B. Ignore burnt cables
   C. Overload every socket
   D. Never touch live wires with wet hands

3. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. CPU
   B. Speaker
   C. Keyboard
   D. Monitor

4. When learning Health and safety in a power mechanics work environment, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Health and safety in a power mechanics work environment.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Health and safety in a power mechanics work environment.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Health and safety in a power mechanics work environment.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Health and safety in a power mechanics work environment.

5. When learning Orthographic projection, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Orthographic projection.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Orthographic projection.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Orthographic projection.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Orthographic projection.

6. When learning Braking system, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Braking system.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Braking system.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Braking system.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Braking system.

7. When learning Isometric projection, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Isometric projection.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Isometric projection.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Isometric projection.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Isometric projection.

8. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Information and Communication Technology
   B. Internal Cooking Timer
   C. International Cricket Team
   D. Input Cable Tester

9. When learning Metalwork processes in power mechanics, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Metalwork processes in power mechanics.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Metalwork processes in power mechanics.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Metalwork processes in power mechanics.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Metalwork processes in power mechanics.

10. When learning Steering system, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Steering system.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Steering system.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Steering system.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Steering system.

11. When learning Suspension system, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Suspension system.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Suspension system.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Suspension system.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Suspension system.

12. When learning Project, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Project.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Project.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Project.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Project.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Four-stroke petrol engine and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Four- Stroke Petrol Engine and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Two-stroke petrol engine and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Two- Stroke Petrol Engine and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
